title: PROBE: Co-Balancing Computation and Communication in MoE Inference via Real-Time Predictive Prefetching
authors: Qianchao Zhu; Xucheng Ye; Yuliang Liu; Haodong Ouyang; Chengru Song
research_focus: MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: Latency-critical MoE inference under expert parallelism (EP) suffers a 'double penalty': expert hotspots create both computational stragglers and bandwidth-bound network congestion in all-to-all collectives. Continuous batching makes the workload temporally volatile (imbalance ratio fluctuates between 1.43 and 2.28 within hundreds of decode steps), so reactive statistic-based rebalancers like DeepSeek-EPLB lag behind abrupt semantic shifts and force ~50% of global compute to idle at synchronization barriers.
problem_statement.zh: 在 expert parallelism（EP）下的延遲敏感型 MoE 推論面臨 double penalty：expert hotspot 同時造成計算 straggler 與 all-to-all 集合通訊的頻寬擁塞。continuous batching 又使工作負載在時序上劇烈波動（imbalance ratio 於數百個 decode step 內介於 1.43 與 2.28），DeepSeek-EPLB 等被動式統計型 rebalancer 因此跟不上突發的語意轉換，使 ~50% 的全域算力於同步屏障閒置。

key_innovation.en: PROBE introduces Continuous Lookahead Pipelining: (1) a Gate-Initialized Lookahead Predictor that clones the next layer's frozen router and adds a trainable residual MLP, distilled online from live traffic to forecast next-layer expert activations at ~90% top-k accuracy; (2) a Hardware-Aware Balance Planner formulated as bounded ILP that respects a per-device 'hiding window'; (3) Phase-Locked Co-Scheduling with split-phase P2P transfers that overlap expert prefetching with compute-bound GEMM while never contending with all-to-all collectives.
key_innovation.zh: PROBE 提出 Continuous Lookahead Pipelining：(1) Gate-Initialized Lookahead Predictor，凍結下一層 router 並接上可訓練 residual MLP，於線上流量持續蒸餾，可在 top-k 達 ~90% 準確率預測下一層的 expert 啟動；(2) Hardware-Aware Balance Planner 以受 device hiding window 約束的 ILP 形式建構；(3) Phase-Locked Co-Scheduling 採 split-phase P2P 傳輸，將 expert prefetch 與 compute-bound GEMM overlap，並避免與 all-to-all 競爭頻寬。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.32x prefill latency reduction (TTFT) and 1.26x decoding throughput improvement over state-of-the-art baselines; reduces average imbalance ratio across 35 layers from 2.13 to 1.09; predictor reaches 87%-94% top-k accuracy and approaches 100% top-half-k recall.
key_improvements.zh: 相較最先進基線，PROBE 將 prefill 延遲（TTFT）最多降低 1.32x、decode 吞吐量提升 1.26x；35 層平均 imbalance ratio 由 2.13 降至 1.09；predictor 達到 87%-94% top-k 準確率，top-half-k recall 近乎 100%。

reported_accuracy: Lookahead predictor: 87%-94% top-K accuracy after online distillation; ~100% top-half-K recall and 2x-top-K recall; 70%-80% accuracy for the untrained baseline (frozen router only)
models_validated: Qwen3-MoE-235B (128 experts, top-8, 93 layers, BF16), GPT-OSS-120B (128 experts, top-4, 36 layers, BF16)
validation_workloads: Chinese (Alpaca-zh), Code (CodeAlpaca-20k, OpenAI-humaneval), Repeat (synthetic high-skew stress test)

scope_assumptions.en: Built on SGLang with DeepEP as communication backend; assumes hybrid parallelism (DP for attention, EP for MoE) and 8x Hopper-141GB single-node deployment with 900 GB/s NVSwitch; the analytical performance model is the bottleneck-rank-latency formulation and is used to motivate the design rather than fitted with reported MAPE; up to three redundant experts per rank are buffered; planner is implemented as a single-SM CUDA kernel with iteration cap k_max=16 to keep the solver under the device hiding window; relies on CUDA Graph compatibility.
scope_assumptions.zh: 建構於 SGLang 之上，以 DeepEP 為通訊後端；假設 hybrid parallelism（attention 採 DP、MoE 採 EP）並部署於 8x Hopper-141GB 單節點、900 GB/s NVSwitch 之硬體；分析式效能模型採用 bottleneck-rank-latency 公式，用於設計動機而非以 MAPE 擬合；每個 rank 至多緩衝三個 redundant expert；planner 實作為單 SM 之 CUDA kernel 並以 k_max=16 迭代上限約束於 hiding window 內；依賴 CUDA Graph 相容性。
